_doc: Provenance of every source photograph the IMG group ships (derivatives only; the sources themselves are fetched into tmp/b1863/images/sources/ by fetch_sources.py and verified by sha256). type: A1 = contemporary primary record (a photograph made in 1863), A2 = later first-hand, B = secondary. Only public-domain or openly licensed sources: nothing from Google Earth, Google Maps, Bing, Maxar or Mapbox.

sources.title: Gateway of cemetery, Gettysburg
sources.creator: Negative by Timothy H. O'Sullivan; positive by Alexander Gardner (Gardner's Photographic Sketch Book of the War, 1866, vol. 1, no. 39)
sources.medium: Albumen print, mounted in an album
sources.repository: Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division (LC-DIG-ppmsca-12560; LCCN 2006692500)
sources.licence: Public domain: Library of Congress rights statement 'No known restrictions on publication'; published 1866, Wikimedia Commons template PD-old-100-1923
sources.verified: LoC item record read 2026-10-19 (created_published 1863 July, c1866; rights_information 'No known restrictions on publication.'). The 6660x5022 file is the Commons copy of the LoC master; it was compared with LoC's own 1024 px service image (cdn.loc.gov .../12560v.jpg): normalised correlation 0.995 after resizing.
sources.uncertain: The brick building is the Evergreen Cemetery gatehouse on Cemetery Hill (Commons category); LoC's subject headings say 'Soldiers' National Cemetery' and its title is 'Gateway of cemetery'.

sources.title: Pennsylvania, Gettysburg, interior view of Breastworks on Round Top.
sources.creator: Negative by Timothy H. O'Sullivan, July 1863; print c. 1865 by Alexander Gardner (handwritten on the mount)
sources.medium: Albumen print from 'Photographic Sketch Book of the Civil War' by Alexander Gardner
sources.repository: U.S. National Archives and Records Administration, Record Group 165 (ARC 533312, local identifier 165-SB-38)
sources.licence: Public domain: U.S. Government holding of a work published in 1866 (Wikimedia Commons: PD-USGov; NARA cooperation template)
sources.verified: Commons file page (NARA-image-full template: ARC 533312, local id 165-SB-38, date 1863-07, author O'Sullivan) read 2026-10-19; the scan itself carries the handwritten caption 'Neg. by T.H. O'Sullivan July 1863 / c. 1865 by A. Gardner' (seen on the file before cropping). The NARA catalogue page needs JavaScript and an API key and could not be read by script.
sources.uncertain: NARA's title says 'Round Top' without saying which hill; the Commons category places it on Little Round Top. The caption uses NARA's wording.
